result.instructions: Tools for Appntmnts, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What open slots do I have for my 30 minute meeting next week?"; "Show me all confirmed bookings for this week."; "Book a 30 minute call for Sam Rivera on July 24 at 14:00.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Appntmnts data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run appntmnts_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run appntmnts_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run appntmnts_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. appntmnts_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: appntmnts_whoami
tools.title: Show the connected account
tools.description: Return the Appntmnts account the API key belongs to: name, username, timezone and public booking URL. Good first call to confirm the connection. Appntmnts API: GET /api/v1/me.

tools.name: appntmnts_list_event_types
tools.title: List event types
tools.description: List the event types (meeting templates) on the account, with duration, kind, price and public booking URL. Use the id or slug from here in the other tools. Appntmnts API: GET /api/v1/event-types.

active_only.description: When true, return only active event types.

tools.name: appntmnts_get_event_type
tools.title: Get an event type
tools.description: Get one event type by numeric id or slug, including duration, location and whether payment is required. Appntmnts API: GET /api/v1/event-types/{idOrSlug}.

tools.name: appntmnts_get_slots
tools.title: Get open slots for one day
tools.description: List the open start times for one event type on one date, honoring its schedule, buffers and existing bookings. Appntmnts API: GET /api/v1/event-types/{idOrSlug}/slots.

date.description: The day to check (yyyy-mm-dd), today or later.

annotations.title: Get open slots for one day

tools.name: appntmnts_list_availability
tools.title: List open slots over a date range
tools.description: List open start times for one event type across up to 31 days. Days with no availability are omitted. Appntmnts API: GET /api/v1/availability.

from.description: First day of the range (yyyy-mm-dd). Defaults to today.

days.description: How many days to scan (1-31, default 7).

annotations.title: List open slots over a date range

tools.name: appntmnts_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings, most recent first, with optional filters for status, date range and event type. Returns one page plus meta (current_page, last_page, total). Appntmnts API: GET /api/v1/bookings.

from.description: Only bookings on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

to.description: Only bookings on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

event_type.description: Only bookings of this event type (id or slug).

tools.name: appntmnts_get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Get one booking by id: status, payment status, customer, scheduled time and meeting URL. Appntmnts API: GET /api/v1/bookings/{id}.

tools.name: appntmnts_create_booking
tools.title: Create a booking
tools.description: Book one open slot for an attendee. The slot must match an open start time from appntmnts_get_slots; otherwise the call fails with HTTP 422. This sends the attendee a confirmation. It is not idempotent: a retry can create a second booking. Appntmnts API: POST /api/v1/bookings.

scheduled_time_start.description: Start time (HH:MM), must match an open slot.

notes.description: Optional note for the booking (max 1000 characters).

tools.name: appntmnts_cancel_booking
tools.title: Cancel a booking
tools.description: Cancel a pending or confirmed booking by id. This sends the normal cancellation e-mails and triggers the account's workflows. It cannot be undone through this API. Appntmnts API: POST /api/v1/bookings/{id}/cancel.

booking_id.description: The booking id to cancel (from appntmnts_list_bookings).
